notes: DeepWell 1.0 brings your paperwork into one place: add PDFs, photos, Word and Excel files, CSV or plain text, one at a time or in batches.
Browse your records by document or customer, explore how they connect, and watch alerts, money owed and paid, and upcoming expiry dates on the dashboard.
Invite your team, prepare warranty claim packets, send customer outreach, and export your documents and customers as CSV whenever you need them.
Donovan answers your questions about your paperwork in plain English and shows the source page with every answer.
It starts from the facts already saved from your documents, so common questions about customers, invoices and visits are quick.
Each answer is checked against the page it cites, Donovan tells you when something is not on file, and it only ever uses your own organization's documents.
Donovan now reads your documents more completely when it answers.
More of your questions are answered from the right page.
The Inbox now shows live progress while your documents are read, with a five-part circle and the time left.
Before a bulk import starts, DeepWell shows what will be imported and what will be skipped.
Refreshing keeps you on the page you were on, and read notifications clear from the bell.
